verses.html: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
verses.text: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

verses.html: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.text: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

verses.html: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
verses.text: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

verses.html: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.html: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
verses.text: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

verses.html: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.text: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

verses.html: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.text: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

verses.html: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
verses.text: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

verses.html: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
verses.text: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

verses.html: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
verses.text: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

verses.html: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
verses.text: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

verses.html: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
verses.text: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

verses.html: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.text: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
